name: apple-suite-mcp
//mcpName: Links this package to server.json for MCP registry ownership verification.
description: Secure, modular, opt-in MCP connector for the Apple app suite (Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, Notes, Mail, Messages, Maps, Photos, Music, Shortcuts).
author: Hanlun Wang <wanghanlunjason@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:native

//: Deps pinned to exact versions (no ^/~, no @latest) per DESIGN.md §5.2. Update deliberately, verify provenance.
Tests use the Node built-in test runner (node:test) — zero extra dev dependencies. Running TS directly needs Node >= 22.6 (CI uses 24); the published dist runs on >= 20.
Swift helper sources ship in the package so `npm run build:native` can compile + sign them locally; prebuilt binaries are never committed or published.
